# Optimum To Report Q3 2026 Financial Results on November 6, 2026 through Form 10-Q


November 04, 2026 8:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_25be9bd173fc44b6454e98a5bb6adb63/alticeusa/news/2026-11-04_Optimum_To_Report_Q3_2026_Financial_Results_on_246.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Optimum Communications (NYSE: OPTU) today announced that it expects to report its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, through its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, which is expected to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on Friday, November 6, 2026.


In light of the Company's ongoing efforts to achieve a comprehensive and consensual restructuring of its capital structure, Optimum will not host an earnings conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. The Company's Form 10-Q will be available on the SEC's website and Optimum's Investor Relations website following its filing.


**About Optimum Communications, Inc.**


Optimum Communications, Inc. (NYSE: OPTU) is one of the largest broadband communications providers in the United States, delivering high-speed internet, video, mobile, and voice services to approximately 4.2 million residential and business customers across 21 states. As a brand built for the future, Optimum is committed to reimagining connectivity and delivering exceptional experiences through next-generation technology and customer-first innovation. The Company also operates Optimum Media, an advanced advertising and data solutions business that enables local, regional, and national brands to reach audiences across screens with precision and scale. Additionally, News 12 – its award-winning hyperlocal news network – provides trusted, community-focused journalism across the tri-state area and beyond.
